description: Dr. Tammy Carpenter, candidate for Oregon House District 27, is done with Band-Aid fixes. Her staunch support for a universal health care system is exactly what Oregon’s health care workers and patients need. Right now, Oregon’s Universal Health Plan Governance Board is developing that universal plan.
